story.head: The Flyers get past the Canucks
paras: Michael Bunting scored his first goal for Philadelphia early in the first to open the scoring. Travis Konecny made it 2-0 on the power play early in the second, and that goal turned out to be the winner. The Flyers went more than 25 minutes without a shot on goal, from midway through the second to late in the third, while the Canucks put 14 on net. Most teams don’t go that long without a shot even once a season. Philadelphia had a goal taken off for offside just 22 seconds into the third, though it didn’t end up costing them. Jonathan Lekkerimäki pulled the Canucks within one on the power play with a little over seven minutes left. Travis Sanheim ended any hope of a comeback with an empty-netter with just under a minute left.

Nothing much separated these two on the chances. This one could have gone either way. Joseph Woll made 18 saves for the Flyers, and Leevi Meriläinen stopped 14 of 16 at the other end. Nobody on the ice had a bigger night than Matvei Michkov, by our Swing measure. The Flyers improved to 5-10-5 and climbed off the bottom of the Metropolitan to sixth, while the Canucks fell to 3-16-1, still last in the NHL.
